frame: fly frame relative to the thorax body: x anterior, y left, z dorsal; rotation = body frame -> thorax frame
phase_alignment: bin 0 of every clip is the LEFT-FRONT (LF) SWING ONSET: the controller's LF adhesion command goes stance -> swing there; phase advances 12 Hz x t, so equal phase = equal gait phase in every clip

encoding.layout: [x, y, z (um), qw, qx, qy, qz (x quat_scale)]
encoding.contact: per phase sample: bitmask, bit i = leg i (order legs) on the ground

escape.note: the viewer raises the wings; the legs stand (no takeoff model)

provenance.controller: flygym_demo.complex_terrain.HybridTurningController (CPG tripod network + preprogrammed steps + adhesion rules)
provenance.world: FlatGroundWorld, fly at z = 0.8 mm, tibia+tarsus ground contact
provenance.speed_definition: mean thorax velocity component along the thorax heading over the 12 recorded cycles; yaw rate = net heading change / time
provenance.note: A recording of a published locomotion controller replayed as an execution model; it is not driven by the brain model.
